# Workflow

This page documents the generic project workflow without conversation content.
The project plans German thematic summaries for personal recall from fallible
university Whisper-v3 JSON.

All conversation files, including authoritative QMD and fictional trial data,
remain permanently external and unversioned. DOCX is the initial review format;
accepted corrections return to external QMD. The drafting skill and schema will
be jointly designed after initialization.

Repository introductions and retained guides contain binding storage/access
rules. No conversation trial or publication has occurred.
